title: Warm Grey Smart-Home Screens with Descriptions
whatItIs: A tall warm-grey page inside a rounded frame with header labels, a home screen phone with a description at each side, and a climate control phone beside a time-picker sheet, each section captioned in small type.
whatItMeans: Warm beige feels calm and domestic, and short captions beside each screen make documentation effortless.
techniques: Small caption blocks left and right of each phone
Warm grey and cream UI on a warm grey page

vocabulary.definition: A short paragraph explaining a nearby screen.
A bottom sheet with scroll columns to choose a time.
A beige or greige used as a base colour.
